Steam Achievements Leak Reveals Unannounced World in Kingdom Hearts 4

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:06
Instaread

A huge Steam leak has revealed the achievements for a plethora of upcoming games, as well as sharing some key details for Kingdom Hearts 4, with Star Wars set to be involved.

Kingdom Hearts 4 is set to be released next year, eight years after its predecessor, and the leaks have revealed some new details for the Square Enix title.

So far, the only reveal directly from Square Enix has been a world inspired by Coco, but the leak suggests a visit to a galaxy far, far away, and other destinations.

Before going any further, consider downloading the free Insider Gaming app for the cleanest way to read your gaming news on iOS and Android.

Star Wars World in Kingdom Hearts 4

A major Steam leak has revealed an achievement tied to Star Wars, with the Desert Do-Gooder achievement awarded for completing all requests in the Galaxy Far, Far Away, a clear hint of a Star Wars world, and the apparent title of the area Sora and company will visit.

The leaks also reveal a host of other worlds the crew will be visiting, including Haunted Mansion, Zootopia, and a world that may be themed around Disney’s theme parks.

Of course, with a long way until launch, the achievements could be altered before the game drops in 2027, but while that’s possible, it’s highly unlikely that major tweaks to the worlds and core content in the game will occur.

  • Related: Huge Steam Leak Reveals Unannounced Games And Achievements

More details about the title and the characters involved will be revealed in due course, but the details officially released so far include the gang of Goofy, Donald Duck, and Mickey Mouse, with appearances from Coco and Hades from Hercules.

A wide range of other characters will be involved, as is customary with a Kingdom Hearts title, and the leaks suggest we could be seeing some familiar faces from Toy Story, alongside new characters.

Check out the Kingdom Hearts 4 teaser trailer below.
